purpose: Define remote output as a governed read-only projection over exact resolved schema/fields unless an explicit delegated write operation is separately authorized.

topics.name: DWH Remote Output Projection
topics.purpose: Define remote output as a governed read-only projection over exact resolved schema/fields unless an explicit delegated write operation is separately authorized.

semantics.resolve_rule: Output resolves exact instance/schema/resource/field identities before projection.
semantics.schema_rule: Field-level output follows resolved schema/classification governance.
semantics.projection_rule: Remote output is a projection and does not create new source ownership.
semantics.readonly_rule: Remote projection is read-only by default.
semantics.redaction_rule: Fields/values may be redacted/omitted according to source policy without changing internal canonical identity.
semantics.lineage_rule: Where exposed, derived/remote results retain appropriate source lineage/provenance.
semantics.materialize_rule: Remote consumer materialization/copy creates separate destination identity under its own explicit write boundary.
semantics.authority_rule: Successful remote read never implies remote write authority.

invariants.rule: Remote DWH sharing exposes only explicitly scoped and schema-governed data; transport reachability, endpoint registration, local authorization or broader local ownership never silently expands delegated remote rights.

hard_gates.condition: restricted field exposed because transport can carry it
consumer cache treated as source identity

references.purpose: Remote projection resolves exact schema/field identities.
